no_estimates.label: No estimates
no_estimates.text: No consensus EPS for the current or next fiscal year.

few_analysts.label: Few analysts
few_analysts.text: Fewer analysts than the minimum behind the EPS estimates.

stale.label: Stale estimates
stale.text: The estimates were downloaded too long ago.

negative_eps.label: EPS ≤ 0
negative_eps.text: A P/E (and PEG) is not meaningful when EPS is zero or negative.

turnaround_base.label: Loss base
turnaround_base.text: EPS0 or EPS1 is zero or negative, so growth is not a rate (a turnaround, not growth).

extreme_growth.label: Extreme growth
extreme_growth.text: EPS growth beyond the plausible range: check the source.

extreme_pe.label: Extreme P/E
extreme_pe.text: P/E beyond the plausible range: usually depressed or one-off EPS.

currency.label: Other currency
currency.text: The company reports, or analysts estimate, in another currency than the share price (most ADRs).

feed_mismatch.label: Feeds disagree
feed_mismatch.text: Yahoo's two estimate feeds disagree on EPS1: one of them is wrong (check before using).

duplicate.label: Second share class
duplicate.text: Another share class of the same company is kept instead.

foreign.label: Based abroad
foreign.text: Headquarters outside the US (kept when it reports in US dollars).

no_profile.label: Awaiting details
no_profile.text: Estimates and profile not downloaded yet.
